fields.label: MCP URL
fields.description: The secret Streamable HTTP URL copied from a WeCom API-mode bot permission page.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current WeCom MCP tool with JSON arguments. Discover the tool first and confirm the user's intent because the endpoint may expose actions that send, overwrite, cancel, or delete WeCom data.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current WeCom MCP tool.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the WeCom MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current tools, behavior annotations, and live input schemas exposed by this WeCom MCP connection.

name.description: The exact WeCom MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by WeCom MCP.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify WeCom data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform a destructive WeCom operation.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeating the same call is expected to have no additional effect.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with entities outside WeCom.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by the connected WeCom server.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by WeCom MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by the connected WeCom MCP endpoint.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed by this WeCom MCP connection.

outputSchema.description: The current WeCom MCP tool catalog.
